$comment: Copy to your project root as rename.config.json. The naming standard should NOT live here — point at it with `extends` so every project shares one. Everything below `extends` is an override for this project only.
$comment_extends: A preset shipped with the skill (aurora, starter), or a path to your team's own file: "../design-system/naming.json". Run `node $S/plan.mjs --print-config` to see the merged result.
$comment_kinds: Narrow this per run rather than renaming everything at once.
$comment_convention: Only what THIS project differs on. An empty block here is the healthy case — it means the project follows the standard. Anything you add is an exception someone will have to justify later. The block below shows the shape; delete it unless you need it.

convention.$comment_transform: The plain operations, for when a glob rule is more machinery than the job needs. Runs after any matching rule. Idempotent, and it will not strip a name to nothing. NOTE: case is `segmentCase` and the number scale is `sizeNaming` — neither belongs in here.

code.$comment: Facts about this repo, not naming decisions — these belong here rather than in the shared standard.
code.$comment_generated: Rebuilt by figma-token-export — the codemod skips them because regenerating overwrites them anyway. EMPTY THIS if the project has no generator, or the codemod will skip exactly the files that need renaming. check.mjs cross-checks it against tokens.config.json targets[].out.
code.$comment_prefix: MUST match this project's tokens.config.json. Wrong here means the codemod matches nothing and silently does no work.
